limitations: EPA BST alignment supported by independent mirror in part of record; full-record timezone/QA not established. NASA dates UTC.
NASA POWER/MERRA2 meteorology is model-derived, not original ERA5.
Observed-data provenance does not establish independent reference-grade QA or exact daily completeness.
Actual source publication latency unverified; results are conditional hindcasts, not operational forecasts.
Lag screen exploratory and multiple comparisons uncorrected; no causal effect or optimal lag claim.
The bootstrap is descriptive conditional uncertainty for these fitted forecasts; no causal interpretation.

reference.assumption: Nominal release BST calendar days compared with published EPA date labels; station-day averaging timezone and original QA remain unresolved. UTC and ±1day sensitivity retained without choosing the best after seeing scores.
reference.comparison_type: Conditional paired independent-point-reference comparison; regional spatial support differs, not causal or operational validation.
reference.bootstrap: Moving calendar blocks of7/30days; conditional sampling intervals, not measurement/model-structural uncertainty.

mirror.point: All four conventions are sensitivity checks, not four independent stations; exact averaging convention remains a source question.
